contract.module_names: Module/package-owned native functions, globals, classes, protocols and categories; canonical metadata validation, private collisions, relocation, template/namespace binding, package invalidation, source-free consumers and GNUstep LLDB expression binding.
contract.structured_runtime: Public C task groups and serial actor mailboxes; nested failure cancellation, retained completion polling, manual pumping, logical hop identities, cleanup-aware joins, two-worker execution and instrumented ASan/LeakSanitizer/UBSan/ThreadSanitizer at O0/O2. Language async/await and compiler actor isolation remain reserved.
contract.spi: Native named partitions and exact-provider grants; ungranted AST declarations omitted; re-exports do not forward privileges. Source/import order, grant revocation, native selector isolation, ARC/MRC projections, embedding API, immutable consumers and tampered metadata are checked. Exported signatures cannot reference imported SPI types or another local group.
contract.availability: Native Clang deprecation, unavailability and platform metadata; complete escaped printing, native diagnostics, capability binding, private implementation reuse, metadata invalidation and source-free tamper rejection. Platform conditions follow native target rules.
contract.public_surfaces: Explicit native root selection, private type leak rejection, canonical tag/typedef lookup, policy-aware package validation, private implementation reuse and public API invalidation.
contract.carriers: Native public Optional/Result types, constructors, queries, copy/move and matching; canonical semantic type guards.
contract.errors: Explicit checked calls, typed throws and local handlers; nested evaluated throwing calls require their own checked form.
contract.optionalization: Always adds one outer Optional, preserving successful absence.
contract.ownership: Explicit ARC/MRC C ABI projections with borrowed id parameters and retained, not-retained or autoreleased native return contracts; canonical producer provenance and transitive consumer-mode re-exports.
contract.packages: Exact SDK seal and explicit language/standard/ownership identities; source-free immutable consumers.
contract.cutover: New compiler patch identity and exact SDK seal require full artifact rebuild. Owned names require objc3.module-owned-names.v1; named SPI requires objc3.api-partitions.v1; availability requires objc3.api-availability.v1. Source/workspace v4, binary package/consumer v3, semantic interface schema 2 and extension ABI 13 remain unchanged.

installed_source_modules.limits: Example module graph, not a general package manager. Build timings exclude full SDK admission and final verification; elapsed timings include both. The native linker runs on every invocation.
